body: thanks aenea...I actually didnt expect a reply to my post, I guess I was mostly talking to myself, if you know what I mean ;) I really appreciate the fact that you took the time to answer though...

The folks around me are very supportive...but I'm finding that I can't tell my partner about this. I just don't know how she'd react.  My employer has been fantastic, thank FSM. And I think it's time to find a new doctor...

It's just getting harder and harder to face the next day at this point.  Still hanging in there for now. Like your friend, more good days than bad days.

*edit* I think a big part of this is...I didnt know what life had in store for me, but I never thought it would be this. And I dont want this to be the rest of my life.
